description: Stocks under the SEC Regulation SHO Rule 201 short sale restriction (SSR) for the current session, as the signal8.ai/short-sale-restriction-list page lists them. SSR is triggered when a stock falls 10% or more below its prior close during regular hours; while in effect, short sales are allowed only above the national best bid, for the rest of that day and the whole next trading day. `today` lists stocks triggered during sessionDate (restricted through the next session); `carriedOver` lists stocks triggered during previousDate (restricted all of sessionDate). On a weekend or holiday sessionDate is the next trading day and `today` is empty. Each row has ticker, name, exchange, triggerDate, triggerAt (ISO), movePct (move at the trigger vs the prior close, null = not measured), source and timeBasis. source "exchange_list" is the listing exchange's published Rule 201 list (Nasdaq-listed stocks), with the exchange's trigger time; source "computed" is Signal8's own reading of stored prices for stocks the exchange list does not cover (or before it is published), with timeBasis "minute_bars" (first regular-hours minute at the trigger, set the next morning) or "first_seen" (when a live price read first showed it; the real trigger can be earlier). A stock missing from the list is not confirmed unrestricted: computed rows are a lower bound. exchangeList says whether the exchange's end-of-day list for each date has been read (final, partial, not_read). The optional ticker narrows both lists to one symbol.

ticker.description: Exact ticker to check (e.g. "AAPL"). Omit for the whole list.
